title: Petrel MCP Failure And Fallback Policy

critical_failures: version_scope missing for a version-sensitive action
tool output cannot be parsed as JSON
fallback_chain: return the policy and next safe action
do not launch Petrel or edit native files
default_policy.retry_policy: No blind retries. Correct inputs or move to a lower-risk read-only tool.
default_policy.manual_intervention: Not required unless the target task needs a new Petrel-authored donor.

critical_failures: requested target version not represented by evidence
generated plan claims an unproven export capability
fallback_chain: query the KB/index for narrower evidence
return design_draft instead of executable status
require donor capture or zero-GUI proof before tool promotion
planning_policy.retry_policy: Retry only after changing the query, target version, or object class list.
planning_policy.manual_intervention: Only needed for donor capture or Petrel-side workflow authoring.

fallback_chain: inspect export package paths directly
run register_and_validate if files exist but manifest is stale
run prepare_mvp if package scaffolding is absent
status_read_only.retry_policy: Retry after refreshing package path or running a read-only status command.

critical_failures: native store locked or partially copied
parser emits zero rows when rows are expected
fallback_chain: preserve raw source files and run a narrower parser
downgrade output to evidence/reference inventory instead of confirmed export
use saved Workflow Editor donor if confirmed Petrel-authored export is required
use deterministic GUI fallback only when zero-GUI cannot produce confirmed rows
zero_gui_file_processing.retry_policy: Retry only with a clean source snapshot or narrowed extraction scope.
cleanup: do not delete preserved raw evidence
zero_gui_file_processing.manual_intervention: Only needed when confirmed Petrel export rows require a donor command.

success_evidence: Petrel run log contains Status: Workflow run OK
critical_failures: Petrel exits without workflow log confirmation
saved Workflow Editor command does not exist
fallback_chain: run dry_run or validate_only first
open the automation copy read-only and inspect the workflow
map native workflow records
use deterministic GUI only to create or validate a donor
fall back to zero-GUI native package preservation
saved_workflow_cli.retry_policy: One retry only after confirming no Petrel process or file lock remains.
saved_workflow_cli.manual_intervention: Needed when the saved workflow or Petrel-side command is absent.

success_evidence: Petrel window title matches expected project
state anchors or approved coordinate fallback succeed
expected export file exists and is non-empty
critical_failures: desktop locked, minimized, or wrong layout
coordinate fallback used without explicit approval
save or CRS dialog not handled
stale or partial output file accepted
fallback_chain: use zero-GUI native/source probe for evidence
import already-saved Petrel ASCII/export file
capture a Petrel-authored donor command for Tier 2
create a new calibrated GUI profile only from screenshot and trace evidence
deterministic_gui.retry_policy: No blind clicks. Retry only after a specific failed anchor is recalibrated or the active Petrel window is corrected.
cleanup: leave raw export artifact for inspection
deterministic_gui.manual_intervention: Required when UI layout, export dialog, or CRS dialog differs from the calibrated profile.

critical_failures: terms too broad to isolate a command record
fallback_chain: rerun with narrower terms
capture before/after Petrel-authored donor snapshots
do not write patches until exact bytes or offsets are proven
native_read_only.retry_policy: Retry with narrower terms or explicit snapshot paths.
native_read_only.manual_intervention: Needed for a new Petrel-authored before/after donor.

success_evidence: restore report and clean compare exist when patch is experimental
critical_failures: target token not unique and no exact offset supplied
Petrel process or project store locked
patched run writes no expected output
fallback_chain: dry-run the patch only
run native analyzers to locate a safer offset
capture another Petrel-authored donor diff
refuse variable-length edits until record lengths and indexes are mapped
native_same_length_patch.retry_policy: Retry only after a fresh snapshot proves the store is restored and expected bytes still match.
cleanup: restore patch unless keep_patch is explicitly requested
native_same_length_patch.manual_intervention: Required when the requested edit changes byte length or object references.

fallback_chain: rerun file registration
quarantine failed rows as partial
re-run source export only for missing artifacts
do not promote package status until validation passes
validation_manifest.retry_policy: Retry after registration refresh or after the missing file is regenerated.
cleanup: write validation report even on failure
validation_manifest.manual_intervention: Only needed if the source Petrel export must be regenerated.

critical_failures: writable launch requested against a non-automation copy
Petrel process already open on a different project
fallback_chain: dry-run command preview
open read-only
ask for manual Petrel save only when editing donors
petrel_launch_project.retry_policy: Retry only after closing or explicitly targeting the active Petrel process.
cleanup: record active PID and title when available

petrel_agent_readiness.tool_purpose: Report the agent-facing readiness contract, tool maturity registry, and client config status.

petrel_tool_creation_hierarchy.tool_purpose: Select the lowest-risk implementation tier before creating a Petrel tool.

petrel_tool_failure_policy.tool_purpose: Describe the failure policy for one MCP tool or all tools.

petrel_status.tool_purpose: Report current package readiness and latest evidence.

petrel_prepare_mvp.tool_purpose: Generate package plans and build sheets without launching Petrel.

petrel_run_mvp.tool_purpose: Run the saved ExportPiloX Workflow Editor bridge from outside Petrel. Safe by default since server 0.7.0: dry_run defaults to true.
critical_failures: dry_run=false passed without deliberate operator intent, which launches Petrel and executes the saved workflow for real
Petrel exits without workflow log confirmation
saved Workflow Editor command does not exist

petrel_open_project.tool_purpose: Prepare or open the automation project for inspection or donor authoring.

petrel_export_well_logs_ui.tool_purpose: Export LAS logs through the mapped Input/Wells GUI path.

petrel_export_well_tops_ui.tool_purpose: Export Well Tops ASCII through the mapped GUI path.

petrel_run_deterministic_gui_workflow.tool_purpose: Run a declarative deterministic GUI fallback workflow such as export_well_tops_ascii.
fallback_chain: run petrel_export_well_tops_native_probe for zero-GUI evidence
import an already-saved Petrel ASCII file
author a Petrel Workflow Editor donor command and move the task to native control

petrel_export_native_zero_gui.tool_purpose: Copy and index the full Petrel native project store without Petrel launch.

petrel_run_zero_gui_export_mvp.tool_purpose: Run raw native copy plus safe semantic extraction without Petrel launch.

petrel_export_native_semantic_zero_gui.tool_purpose: Extract safe semantic metadata from copied native stores.

petrel_export_surfaces_zero_gui.tool_purpose: Decode native .zhz surface arrays to XYZ CSV and ZMAP+ with mask-gated layout validation and SEG-Y-derived georeferencing, without launching Petrel.
critical_failures: native store locked or partially copied
data/mask footprint agreement below the 99.9% gate treated as exported instead of layout_unresolved

petrel_write_well_tops_ascii.tool_purpose: Write a Petrel Well Tops ASCII (VERSION 2) file from CSV marker picks in the exact Petrel 2018.2 dialect, with re-parse verification.
critical_failures: input CSV missing required well/surface/x/y/z columns
rows silently dropped without being counted in rows_skipped_missing_required
dialect deviation (line endings, quoting, undefined markers) from the Petrel-authored reference export

petrel_las_convert.tool_purpose: Convert a Petrel-exported LAS well log to CSV with a curve/unit/range summary.
critical_failures: curves dropped without appearing in the summary
null value not preserved in the summary

petrel_project_audit_report.tool_purpose: Generate a self-contained HTML + JSON project audit from export-package evidence files, without launching Petrel.
critical_failures: audit claims data that no evidence file supports
missing evidence rendered as populated sections instead of not-available notes

petrel_export_seismic_zgy_zero_gui.tool_purpose: Read native ZGY cubes with pyzgy and export geometry reports, mid-slices, and optional full volumes without launching Petrel.
critical_failures: pyzgy dependency missing (must preflight-fail, not crash mid-read)
cube reported exported without a written report

petrel_survey_geometry.tool_purpose: Report seismic survey origin, inline/xline vectors, rotation, bin size, and CRS from a Petrel-authored SEG-Y export. Read-only.

petrel_grid_convert.tool_purpose: Convert gridded surface files between ZMAP+ and XYZ CSV in the project's zmapio dialect as part of the extract-process-import chain.
critical_failures: irregular scatter passed where a regular lattice is required (must fail closed as irregular_grid)
silent canvas change: reconstructed ZMAP canvas is the live-node bounding box and must be reported, not hidden

petrel_export_well_tables_zero_gui.tool_purpose: Derive well headers, curve inventory, and conservative well-top references from package data.
critical_failures: curve parser cannot read LAS files
well-top references are mistaken for confirmed marker-pick rows
fallback_chain: rerun LAS export or native store export
label well-top rows as reference evidence only
use Petrel-authored Well Tops ASCII export for confirmed marker-pick rows

petrel_export_well_tops_native_probe.tool_purpose: Probe native/package files for clean well-top evidence and source-ASCII fallback rows.
critical_failures: native binary-adjacent strings pollute CSV output
fallback_chain: canonicalize top names against known project evidence
keep native_binary_confirmed=no
use deterministic GUI Well Tops ASCII export for confirmed rows

petrel_import_gui_well_tops_table.tool_purpose: Import pasted Petrel GUI Well Tops table as validation evidence.

petrel_register_and_validate.tool_purpose: Register generated artifacts and validate checksums.

petrel_native_map_workflow.tool_purpose: Map workflow regions in native .ptd stores without writing.

petrel_native_compare_snapshots.tool_purpose: Compare native snapshots and report diffs.

petrel_native_patch_string.tool_purpose: Guarded same-length string patch in a native store.

petrel_native_patch_offset.tool_purpose: Guarded exact-offset patch in a native store.

petrel_export_segy_filename_patch.tool_purpose: Patch a saved ExportSeismicCmd filename tail, run Petrel, validate, and restore.

petrel_export_segy_token_patch.tool_purpose: Patch a saved ExportSeismicCmd output token, run Petrel, validate, and restore.

petrel_analyze_exportseismiccmd_records.tool_purpose: Read-only map of saved ExportSeismicCmd records.

petrel_analyze_workflow_command_clone_re.tool_purpose: Read-only gate that reports whether Petrel-authored command donor evidence is sufficient for safe zero-GUI Workflow Editor command cloning.
success_evidence: current command records are mapped from live Data.ptd
first and second donor compare reports are loaded
readiness gates are written to JSON and CSV
critical_failures: current command records cannot be bounded
donor compare reports missing or stale
tool writes or patches native stores
fallback_chain: capture another Petrel-authored donor diff
map BXML/LZ4 length fields and command-list indexes
keep using same-length parameter patch-run-restore tools only

petrel_analyze_workflow_clone_side_effec.tool_purpose: Read-only analyzer that classifies Data.ptd and Model.ptd side effects from Petrel-authored command donor diffs before any zero-GUI command clone is attempted.
success_evidence: first and second donor compare reports are loaded
critical_failures: side_effects_isolated=true while blocking Model.ptd/Data.ptd side effects remain
tool writes or patches native stores
fallback_chain: map Model.ptd UI/object-reference updates
map Data.ptd command-list/index updates
capture a cleaner Petrel-authored donor diff
keep using same-length parameter patch-run-restore tools only

petrel_analyze_workflow_clone_storage_bl.tool_purpose: Read-only analyzer that splits mixed ExportSeismicCmd command payload bytes from Data.ptd store-growth blocks before any zero-GUI command clone is attempted.
success_evidence: first and second donor compare reports are loaded
storage block segment CSV is written
storage block summary CSV is written
critical_failures: command payload bounds cannot be mapped
storage_payload_separated=true while mixed payload/store-growth segments remain
tool writes or patches native stores
fallback_chain: run petrel_analyze_workflow_clone_side_effects
inspect storage block segment CSV
map neighbor/extended record semantics
map Data.ptd index/page churn and Model.ptd side effects
keep using same-length parameter patch-run-restore tools only

petrel_extract_workflow_command_clone_re.tool_purpose: Read-only extractor that saves candidate command payload evidence from Petrel-authored donor diffs and blocks application until structural clone gates are mapped.
success_evidence: first and second donor compare reports are loaded
candidate payload binary files are written under the report directory
critical_failures: added command records cannot be detected
payload mutation, side-effect, payload-signal, or negative-control evidence is missing
tool writes or patches native stores
fallback_chain: run petrel_analyze_workflow_command_clone_readiness
capture a cleaner Petrel-authored donor diff
map BXML/LZ4 length fields and command-list indexes
keep using same-length parameter patch-run-restore tools only

petrel_export_systemcmd_token_patch.tool_purpose: Patch a saved SystemCmd bridge token, run Petrel, validate, and restore.

petrel_analyze_systemcmd_records.tool_purpose: Read-only map of saved SystemCmd records.

petrel_generate_workflow_from_okf.tool_purpose: Generate workflow scaffolds from version-scoped OKF retrieval evidence.

petrel_validate_workflow_coverage.tool_purpose: Validate manifest coverage against expected object types and formats.

petrel_query_kb.tool_purpose: Query local Petrel knowledge evidence before designing automation.
